definitions.full: H8619. taqoa תָּקוֺעַ noun [masculine] a blast-(wind-) instrument (si vera lectio); — absolute בַּתּ ׳תָּקַע Ezek 7:14 (but strike out ב , and treat תָּקוֺעַ as infinitive, so Co and modern).
